_comment: Sanitized Claude Code state seed for fresh CI runners. coder/agentapi drives an INTERACTIVE `claude`, which on a pristine HOME blocks on first-run TUI gates (theme picker, trust-folder dialog, --dangerously-skip-permissions confirmation) and so never reaches agentapi's 'stable' status -> the review times out. agentapi-claude.sh MERGES this into $HOME/.claude.json whenever claude is not already onboarded (jq-gated on hasCompletedOnboarding!=true, so it also covers the empty stub the installer leaves), then injects per-project trust for the CWD + each --add-dir path, so the runner looks like an already-onboarded, trusted, settled install and `claude` boots straight to ready. Contains NO secrets and NO PII: auth still rides on the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN env secret, never a committed credential. Locally this file is never used (your real ~/.claude.json is already onboarded). If a future claude re-triggers onboarding after a version bump, bump lastOnboardingVersion.
